_comment: Which horizon a body comes up over, said about the body its clause minted. Eight points and no
more -- the four cardinals and the four between them are what a person points at, where 22.5
degrees is a question the Art keeps away from a writer.
Due east is vanilla's own, so `an east-rising sun` is a sun where the sun has always been. It is
still worth a page: a writer who has moved one sun wants to say where the others are.
